name: Boiler furnace and membrane water walls
description: Radiant heat-release enclosure around the flame. Fire-tube boilers confine the flame in a large furnace tube surrounded by water; water-tube boilers use finned membrane wall panels in which the furnace walls themselves form evaporator surface. Cooling the gas before the reversal chamber and limiting metal subcooling during cycling are central to tube life.

specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco: flame temperature in shell-boiler furnace tubes may be up to 1,800 C

specifications.metric: gas temperature before reversal, plain steel
specifications.basis: Minimum cooling to 420 C before a plain-steel reversal chamber

specifications.metric: gas temperature before reversal, alloy steel
specifications.basis: Minimum cooling to 470 C before an alloy-steel reversal chamber
B&W: if lower-furnace subcooling is limited to 100 F (56 C) there is a low probability of cycling damage
Spirax Sarco: water-tube boilers use finned tube membranes for furnace walls
